verdict.rationale: Sumsub docs mention 'Summy AI' as a built-in assistant that can build verification levels from plain-language descriptions and summarize applicant status/rejection reasons/next steps, which is direct evidence of task delegation to an in-product AI assistant. However, evidence only covers two narrow use cases (level building, applicant overview) rather than a general-purpose assistant, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of how broadly it can act. Missing for 10: broader task coverage beyond level-building and applicant overviews, independent verification of the assistant's actual capabilities, and details on user-facing invocation/UX.
